about: GitHub owners whose skills keel's skills step may offer to install without an Anthropic marketplace listing. Each owner was checked by hand on the date given: who they are and why their published skills can be trusted. A skill from any other owner is offered only when it is in Anthropic's official marketplace. Add an owner only after the same check.

owners.why: Anthropic, the maker of Claude Code: its skills and plugin repositories.
Trail of Bits, a security firm; keel already lists its marketplace (trailofbits/skills) in data/stack-skills.json.
